endorsements.name: Abraham Kang
endorsements.label: Code Reviewing Web Application Framework Based Applications (Struts 2, Spring MVC, Ruby on Rails (Groovy on Grails), .NET MVC)
endorsements.description: This workshop will give participants an opportunity to practically review Web Application Framework based applications for security vulnerabilities. The material in this workshop provides the hands-on experience that one would need to quickly understand each web application framework (Struts 2, Spring MVC, Ruby on Rails (Groovy on Grails), .NET MVC, Zend PHP, and Scala Play) and identify vulnerabilities in applications using those frameworks. Sample applications are provided with guided tasks to ease participants into understanding the nuances of each framework and the overall steps a code reviewer should follow to identify vulnerabilities.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2012

endorsements.name: Abraham Kang
endorsements.label: Resting on Your Laurels will get you Pwned: Effectively Code Reviewing REST Applications to avoid getting powned
endorsements.description: Public REST APIs have become mainstream. It is not just startups such as Facebook and twitter at the fore front of the REST revolution. Now, almost every company that wants to expose services or an application programming interfaces does it using a publicly exposed REST API. Although, many people have given talks about attacking REST APIs from a pen-tester's point of view –little discussion has occurred related to application layer vulnerabilities in REST APIs. This talk gives code reviewers the skills they need to identify and understand REST vulnerabilities at the application code level. The findings are a result of reviewing production REST applications as well as researching popular REST frameworks.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 21
